title: Webhook notifications
description: Send store events to chat robots or a generic HTTPS webhook.
name: Channel name
keep: Leave blank to keep the saved value
security: URLs and credentials are encrypted. Only public HTTPS addresses on port 443 are accepted. Save changes before testing.
genericHelp: Generic JSON works with n8n and other automation tools. Payload: event, resource_id, text, timestamp. Use a published production webhook with POST enabled.
deliveryHelp: Each event is attempted once per channel. Failed sends are recorded; automatic retries are not enabled. Event notifications include a resource ID without customer details.

errors.validation: Enter a name, platform, language and at least one event.
errors.url: Enter a valid public HTTPS webhook URL for this platform (port 443).
errors.delivery: Delivery failed. Check the webhook address, signing secret, keyword and robot permissions.
errors.encryption: Configure WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY or a non-default COOKIE_SECRET on the server.
errors.missing: This notification channel no longer exists.
errors.request: The request failed. Please try again.
